subject: Trading
title: Panic Selling
description: A fast breakdown of Panic Selling for builders.

hook.text: The market drops 5% in a day. Your portfolio is deep red. Your finger hovers over 'sell all.' That's panic.

buildup.text: Panic selling is the fear-driven liquidation of positions during rapid declines, often at the worst prices.

discovery.text: Studies show most retail investors sell near market bottoms and buy near tops—emotional timing is backwards.

twist.text: The March 2020 COVID crash: those who panic-sold missed a 100% recovery within 18 months.

climax.text: Having a plan before the panic—stop-losses, allocation rules—removes emotion from the equation.

punchline.text: Plan your exit before you need one.

quiz.question: What typically happens to investors who panic sell during crashes?
options: They sell near the bottom and miss the recovery
